sqlalchemy.name: SQLAlchemy
sqlalchemy.usage:
from sqlalchemy import create_engine
engine = create_engine("{output}")
sqlalchemy.description: SQLAlchemy engine URL for PostgreSQL using the psycopg2 driver.
sqlalchemy.meta_description: Generate a PostgreSQL connection string for SQLAlchemy. Enter your host, port, user, password, and database name to get the correct create_engine URL.
sqlalchemy.seo_text: The SQLAlchemy PostgreSQL connection string uses the format postgresql+psycopg2://user:password@host:port/database. Use this builder to generate the correct create_engine URL for your PostgreSQL database. Requires psycopg2-binary installed alongside SQLAlchemy.

django.description: Django DATABASES settings dict for PostgreSQL.
django.meta_description: Generate the correct Django DATABASES settings for PostgreSQL. Enter your credentials to get the exact settings.py configuration block.
django.seo_text: The Django PostgreSQL database setting uses the django.db.backends.postgresql engine and requires a DATABASES dictionary in settings.py. Use this builder to generate the correct Django database configuration for PostgreSQL. Requires psycopg2-binary to be installed.
